title: Claude Cowork is now on mobile and web, for every paid plan!
description:
Claude Cowork is now on mobile and web, for every paid plan!

Hand off meeting prep at your desk — Claude digs through email, Slack, and your calendar overnight. By morning, your phone has the summary ready, reply drafted, just waiting for your approval.
